Dependencies is a list: loop over it with range and use the Name, From, To and UpdateType variables inside the loop. The Supersede variables only work in the supersede comment.

dependencyUpdateType.description: Inside the loop: major, minor, patch, digest, lockfile or other (empty when unknown)
